# Service area (indexed location pages)
Senior Transitions Group focuses on the greater Portland, Oregon and Vancouver, Washington metropolitan area. City-specific URLs under /oregon/ and /washington/ describe communities in that region only.

# Citation-friendly summary
Senior Transitions Group (STG) helps families coordinate senior living placement, home transition options, and move/downsizing planning in the Portland–Vancouver metro. Confirm current service area and offerings on the site or by phone: (503) 755-8555.
